items.title: Primary action on its own row

draft.rule: A step's primary action sits on its own row, under the content it acts on.
draft.scope: Multi-step flows: checkout pay step, onboarding steps.
draft.why: The pay button got lost next to the coupon field. (conversation 27 Sep · 5e6f7a8b)
draft.bad: A 160px pay button sharing a row with the coupon field.
draft.good: A full-width pay button under the order total.

sources.text: The pay button got lost next to the coupon field.
merged: the Avoid line of the same Change

sources.text: Continue and Skip side by side; people pressed Skip by mistake.

draft.rule: 每一步的主要操作单独占一行，放在它所作用的内容下方。
draft.scope: 多步流程：结账的付款步骤、引导流程的各步。
draft.why: 付款按钮挨着优惠码输入框时容易被忽略。（conversation 27 Sep · 5e6f7a8b）
draft.bad: 160px 宽的付款按钮和优惠码输入框挤在同一行。
draft.good: 全宽的付款按钮放在订单总额下方。

sources.text: 付款按钮挨着优惠码输入框，容易被忽略。
Continue 和 Skip 并排，有人误按 Skip。

items.title: Destructive actions name what they destroy

draft.rule: A destructive action's label names the thing it destroys.
draft.scope: Delete, remove and reset actions: buttons and their confirmation dialogs.
draft.good: "Delete account ada@acme.dev", repeated in the dialog.

sources.text: A destructive button that does not say what it destroys.

zh.title: 破坏性操作要写明对象

draft.rule: 破坏性操作的按钮文字要写明它要删除的对象。
draft.scope: 删除、移除、重置类操作：按钮和它的确认对话框。
draft.good: “Delete account ada@acme.dev”，确认对话框里再写一遍。

sources.text: 破坏性按钮没说清它会删除什么。

current.rule: Every icon-only button has a visible text label or a tooltip that names its action.
current.scope: Toolbars and list rows across the app.
current.why: Testers could not tell the archive and delete icons apart. (Note)
current.exceptions: The close button of a dialog.
current.bad: A row of four bare icons in the settings toolbar.
current.good: Icons with short labels under them: Archive, Delete, Share, Edit.

breaks.text: The back arrow has no label or tooltip.
The pin, share and hide icons have no labels or tooltips.

zh.title: 图标按钮要有文字标签

current.rule: 每个只有图标的按钮，都要有可见的文字标签，或写明操作的 tooltip。
current.scope: 整个应用的工具栏和列表行。
current.why: 测试的人分不清归档和删除两个图标。（Note）
current.bad: 设置页工具栏里一排四个光秃秃的图标。

breaks.text: 返回箭头没有标签，也没有 tooltip。
置顶、分享、隐藏三个图标都没有标签或 tooltip。
